content.what_it_is: Fortran module GLOBAL (MODULE GLOBAL @L13 ... END MODULE @L2737) of EFDC+ (header @L1-11: DSI LLC copyright 2021-2024, GNU GPLv2, '@details This module creates variables that modified globally by various subroutines', author Paul M. Craig, '@date 2015-06 IMPLEMENTED SIGMA-Z (SGZ) IN EE'). It contains only declarations - no executable statements: kind/precision parameters (dp @L19, RKD/RK4/IK8/IKV/IK4 @L21-25), fixed file-unit parameters 301-308 (@L27-34), and module-level global state grouped by commented sections: main controls and hydrodynamics option flags (@L39-77), time/timestepping incl. dynamic timestep bounds (@L79-117), CPU-timing accumulators (@L119-146), restart (@L148-174), OpenMP (@L176-181), structured grid and cell connectivity (@L183-333), Sigma-Z (SGZ) vertical grid arrays (@L335-468), blocked layer faces (@L470-488), channel modifiers/pipes (@L490-511), waves incl. derived type WAVE @L516-529 and wave parameters WLMIN/WLMAX/EPS/QQMAX/WHMI @L546-550, SWAN linkage type CELL @L578-583 (@L577-588), boundary-condition forcing time series counters/arrays (@L590-740) with derived type TSR @L710-717 and typed series TSFL/TSPS/TSWR/TSATM/TSWND/TSSAL/... (@L720-735), transport state arrays SAL/TEM/DYE/SFL/TOX/SED/SND/WQV with previous-timestep pairs (@L742-760), volatilization type VOLTYPE @L767-775, dye class type DYECLASS @L777-789, toxics types TOXCLASS @L791-804 and TOX_DEPOSITION @L810-820, water-column pointer type WCVPOINTER @L825-830, hydrodynamics scalars/arrays incl. turbulence closure and external-mode solver coefficients (@L835-1400), vegetation (@L1402-1437), boundary conditions incl. open-boundary East/North/South/West index and series arrays (@L1439-1554), hydraulic structures (@L1556-1571) and derived types POINT_SOURCE @L1580-1594, HYDRAULIC_STRUCTURES @L1596-1629, WITHDRAWAL_RETURN @L1631-1646, JETPLUME @L1650-1683 with local/global instances BCPS/HYD_STR/WITH_RET/JET_PLM (@L1685-1695), temperature/heat and atmospheric forcing (@L1697-1756), ice (@L1758-1808), shellfish larvae (@L1810-1838), ChemFate toxics (@L1841-1917), sediment transport SedTran (@L1920-2151), hard-bottom edge type BEDEDGE @L2154-2157 with four instances (@L2159-2162), bank erosion (@L2164-2199), propwash (@L2201-2208), cross-section fluxes (@L2210-2214), SEDZLJ sediment-flux model block (@L2218-2323), Lagrangian drifters incl. oil-spill fields (@L2328-2376), MHK marine hydrokinetic devices (@L2378-2423), OpenMP temporary work arrays (@L2425-2452), NetCDF output (@L2454-2485), high-frequency output (@L2487-2493), low-chord QCTL variables (@L2495-2500), wind sheltering rotation (@L2502-2505), time blocks (@L2507-2516), food-chain linkage (@L2518-2525), GOTM turbulence (@L2527-2540), debug variables (@L2543-2550), COARE36 (@L2552-2557), heat-flux outputs (@L2559-2562), legacy time series output (@L2564-2594), residuals/CALMMT low-pass filter accumulators (@L2596-2645), and WASP/ICM/RCA linkage (@L2648-2730). The only preprocessor conditional is #ifdef GNU @L2732-2736 selecting FMT_BINARY as character(11) 'UNFORMATTED' (GNU) or character(6) 'BINARY'. Many array declarations carry the 'target' attribute for pointer association (e.g. HP @L268, U @L1335, V @L1352, W @L1371, QSUM @L2267 area); allocation happens elsewhere.

unresolved: L209: LWC doc comment reads 'Index of the cell to the SOUTH of the current L', duplicating LSC's comment @L206; by the neighbor naming pattern LNC/LEC/LSC (@L202/205/206) LWC should be WEST - name/comment inconsistency across L206 vs L209.
L1157-1158: DV comment 'Temporary delta U array' duplicates DU's comment @L1157; DV presumably delta V - copy error across adjacent lines.

L2082-2083: SEDB is described 'Sedb - Previous timestep' while SEDB1 is 'Initial cohesive sediment bed concentration'; elsewhere the X/X1 convention is current/previous (e.g. HBED @L2032 vs HBED1 @L2033) - the two comments appear swapped.

L1945-1946 and L1950/1952: NSCM and NSED carry the identical comment 'Number of cohesive sediment classes', NSND and NSNM the identical 'Number of non-cohesive sediment classes'; the distinction between each pair is not stated in this file.
L1949: NSEDS2 comment says '2*NSCM' while the naming pattern (NSED2='2*NSED' @L1947, NSND2='2*NSND' @L1951) suggests 2*NSEDS - inconsistent comment.

Variables flagged 'delme' but still declared: NDPSER @L709, NFLTMT @L924, RKTOXP @L1279 ('PHOTOLOSIS BASE RATE (NOT IMPLEMENTED) DELME'), CBEDTOTAL @L2022 ('delme - move to ssedtox') - retention status unresolved.
L87: DAYNEXT declaration is commented out while the same 'next whole ...' family HOURNEXT/HOUR06NEXT/HOUR12NEXT @L88-90 is active; where DAYNEXT is declared instead is not visible in this file.
L76-77: IS2TIM and IS2TL carry identical comments 'Time stepping option: 0 - 3TL, 1 - 2TL'; their functional difference is not stated here.
L1399-1400: ZZ is annotated '(LCM,KCM)' and ZZC '(KCM,LCM)' - index-order swap asserted only in comments; actual shapes are set at allocation elsewhere.
L371, L449-450: LKSZ 'TRUE = NOT ACTIVE' and LSGZU/LSGZV 'layer active flag (.TRUE.=inactive)' - flag polarity is inverted relative to the names.
L52 IWRSP comment is only 'SEDZLJ' and L1972 IWRSPB only 'SedTran'; semantics of both are not defined in this file.
SEDZLJ block L2263-2322: array shapes are asserted only in trailing comments (e.g. '!(KB,LCM)', '!(LCM,NSEDS)'); allocation and thus actual shapes are elsewhere.
Numerous declarations carry empty '!<' doc comments (e.g. ISWRSR @L533, ISWVSD @L534, shellfish block @L1812-1838, SEDMDMN..SNDVDRD @L2002-2010); their meanings are not stated in this file.
L616: NPSERM comment contains the corrupted text '<aximum' (apparent typo for 'Maximum').
L699: NMAXBC and MSVDOX are declared together without any comment; roles not stated in this file.
